sentences.text: The documents do not state that a gold loan has a 5% pre-payment charge.

The in-force bank documents shown state 2% of principal outstanding in one home loan agreement and 3% of principal outstanding in a copy, and the UCB directions say that in cases other than paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.

missing.slot: whether this gold loan has a 5% pre-payment charge
whether this gold loan falls under paragraph 261(1) or (2), or under the approved policy of a UCB
missing.searched: gold loan applicability to UCB pre-payment charge rules
